title: Area formula for an injective map on a Borel subset of a single Simon C¹ chart
statement: Let n, N, N′ ∈ ℕ (ℝᵈ = EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d)), M ⊆ ℝᴺ, and V ⊆ ℝⁿ, W ⊆ ℝᴺ, ψ : ℝⁿ → ℝᴺ with IsSimonLocalRepresentation 1 M V W ψ. That is: V and W are open; ψ is C¹ on V and injective on V; ψ(V) = W ∩ M; ψ is proper relative to V and W; and Dψ(x) is injective for x ∈ V. Assume tangentSpace M (ψ x) = range Dψ(x) for every x ∈ V. Let B ⊆ W ∩ M be a Borel set. Let f : ℝᴺ → ℝ^{N′} be differentiable at every y ∈ B, with injective derivative Df(y) for every y ∈ B, and injective on B. Then μHE[n](f(B)) = ∫⁻_{y∈B} ofReal(areaJacobian(Df(y) ∘ ι_y)) dμHE[n](y). Here ι_y : tangentSpace M y → ℝᴺ is the inclusion (subtypeL) and areaJacobian(K) = √det(K* ∘ K).
lean_statement: ∀ (n N N' : ℕ) (M : Set (Rn N)) (V : Set (Rn n)) (W : Set (Rn N)) (ψ : Rn n → Rn N) (f : Rn N → Rn N') (B : Set (Rn N)), Chapter02.IsSimonLocalRepresentation 1 M V W ψ → (∀ x ∈ V, tangentSpace M (ψ x) = LinearMap.range (fderiv ℝ ψ x).toLinearMap) → MeasurableSet B → B ⊆ W ∩ M → (∀ y ∈ B, DifferentiableAt ℝ f y) → (∀ y ∈ B, Function.Injective (fderiv ℝ f y)) → InjOn f B → μHE[n] (f '' B) = ∫⁻ y in B, ENNReal.ofReal (areaJacobian ((fderiv ℝ f y).comp (tangentSpace M y).subtypeL)) ∂μHE[n]
